subject: integration
name: Web3 Score standard (WEB3_SCORE_0_1)
summary: A definition of WEB3_SCORE_0_1: one read function, websiteScore, that takes the address a page would open (ipfs://, a .eth name or a bare name) and answers a provider's name and a Website level from 1 to 4, or null. The address goes to the Web3 Score providers the person has on, and a name is resolved first. The definition says a 3 or 4 is answered only for a name the evaluation lists or the content's own address, and null when a provider is down; it cannot check that a level is right. The row names no provider. Level 4 with privacy as a definition. Judged here by its publisher.
